name: Gasthaus am Zierwald
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to Gasthaus am Zierwald in Tirol**

Discover authentic Tyrolean hospitality in the heart of the Alps. Our cozy inn, nestled in the picturesque **Zierwald** region, invites you to experience the warmth of **Tirol**’s traditional charm.

Savor classic dishes like hearty **Kaiserschmarrn**, crispy **Speckknödel**, and tender **Tiroler Gröstl**, all crafted with local ingredients. After a day of hiking, skiing, or exploring **Innsbruck** or the **Ötztal**, unwind in our rustic dining room or on the sunny terrace with a glass of crisp **Tiroler Bier** or a smooth **Grauburgunder**.

Our rooms blend alpine simplicity with modern comfort—whether you choose a cozy **Zimmer** with mountain views or a family-friendly **Familienzimmer**. Relax by the crackling fireplace or stroll through the lush forests and meadows right outside your door.

Just a short drive from **Tirol’s** most famous attractions, **Gasthaus am Zierwald** is your perfect base for adventure and relaxation. **Willkommen in Tirol!**
